lead: The landscape of artificial intelligence continues to evolve rapidly, with significant developments from major tech companies, regulatory changes, and emerging challenges in ethics and safety.

stories.title: Nvidia, OpenAI and Anthropic to be named AI national champions, WSJ reports
stories.summary: The Trump administration plans to designate Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic as AI national champions to bolster U.S. firms against Chinese competition. This initiative aims to enhance the global presence of American AI companies. The announcement is expected to include over two dozen firms as part of this strategic move.

stories.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
stories.summary: In the wake of a scandal involving Nvidia's former CEO and alleged espionage, Congress is considering stricter regulations on the export of AI chips. Both parties are pushing for measures to ensure national security and prevent sensitive technology from falling into the wrong hands.

stories.title: Apple needs your help to make health AI better
stories.summary: Apple is launching a new app aimed at improving AI in health by gathering user feedback on health-related AI tools. This initiative seeks to evaluate how effectively these tools respond to medical inquiries and enhance their usability for everyday users.

stories.title: Reports of AI-related child sexual abuse material rise 8,400% in two years, data shows
stories.summary: A shocking report reveals that the use of AI in the creation of child sexual abuse material has surged by over 8,400% in just two years. This alarming trend has prompted calls for governments to treat it as a public health emergency and take urgent action to combat the exploitation.

stories.title: Elon Musk joins 165,000 others calling for Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang in open letter
stories.summary: Elon Musk and other tech leaders are advocating for the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia following his recent ousting. The situation has sparked widespread debate about leadership stability in the AI sector and its implications for the industry.

stories.title: Your AI is smarter. Is your business still working the same way?
stories.summary: Despite advancements in AI capabilities, many businesses are struggling to adapt their workflows accordingly. This article discusses how organizations can better integrate AI into their processes to enhance overall performance rather than just speeding up individual tasks.

stories.title: Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max flagship AI model without open weights
stories.summary: Alibaba has introduced its latest AI model, Qwen4-Max, which is designed to assist in various work and creative tasks. However, the company has opted to keep the model's weights closed, raising questions about accessibility and collaboration in AI development.

stories.title: Apple launches new app to study how people use AI for health
stories.summary: Apple has launched a new app aimed at studying user interactions with AI health tools. The initiative seeks to gather data on the effectiveness of these tools in providing medical information and improving user experience.
